messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert fired for service=redwood-runtime region=us-east-az2 severity=high :rotating_light:
PagerDuty: Incident #INC2400123456 created and sent to Eric (oncall). Escalation policy: az2-runtime-oncall.
Eric (oncall): acked the page — looking now. grabbing logs.
Eric (oncall): Seeing 503 spikes and streaming timeouts for model-shard-12 on az2. Load jump ~3.2x in last 5m.
Maya (infra): copying — I see the autoscaler trying to spin new pods but kube pods stuck in ContainerCreating with GPU bind error.
Sandeep (runtime): that matches KV cache eviction traces i’m seeing. Shard12 KV cache hitting pressure, OOM kill on worker-7.
Kai (support): any customer impact? Zendesk ticket #8421 just popped, 10 customers reporting degraded responses and intermittent errors.
Jess (product): flagging potentially impacted customers: internal tier customers in us-east with pinned model v2.0. Priority to notify if SLA breach imminent.
Eric (oncall): Quick mitigation plan: 1) Trigger regional fallback to model-shard-12 fallback variant in us-east 2) Disable continuous batching for shard-12 3) Kick manual restart of worker-7 nodes.
Maya (infra): executing node restarts: running `kubectl rollout restart deploy/worker-7 -n runtime-us-east` — will monitor events.
Sandeep (runtime): deploying fallback routing: updating routing policy to route shard-12 requests to shard-12-fallback on az1/az3. Command: ```rbxctl route set --shard model-shard-12 --to shard-12-fallback --region us-east --dry-run=false```
Maya (infra): Node restarts show `FailedMount: MountVolume.SetUp failed for volume "gpu-nvidia"`. Looks like driver mount race on node upgrade. Rolling nodes one at a time.
Eric (oncall): Ack from PD noted. Activated fallback routing. :white_check_mark: Observability: p95 latency down from 2.8s -> 1.1s for affected routes.
Kai (support): posting status update to customers: "We're investigating intermittent errors in us-east. We've routed requests to fallback instances. Expect improved performance within minutes."
PagerDuty: Eric (oncall) acknowledged at 2400123462. Escalation paused.
Sandeep (runtime): KV cache eviction logs snippet: ```ERROR runtime::kv_cache: eviction_warning: hash_table_load 0.92; attempting compaction. killed process pid=10321 (oom)```
Maya (infra): Found one node with conflicting driver version after recent patch. Marking node `us-east-az2-node-44` cordon/drain and scheduling replacement. `kubectl drain us-east-az2-node-44 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`
Eric (oncall): After fallback activation, error rate dropped 78% for affected customers. Some long-tail 503s from in-progress connections.
Jess (product): Good. Can we quantify SLA exposure? Kai — tally affected customers on pinned model v2.0 and projected credit exposure.
Kai (support): Initial list: 12 orgs with pinned v2.0, 3 showing >20% error rate spikes. Estimating potential credits if >5% error sustained >15m.
Sandeep (runtime): Long-term mitigation: patch runtime to better handle KV cache compaction and avoid full process OOM; will open PR with telemetry and soft-limit.
Eric (oncall): Handoff plan — I'm going to stabilize and then H/T to Sandeep for postmortem and root cause. Eric -> Sandeep in 30m.
Maya (infra): Node replacement started, new node joined cluster, driver installed cleanly. Monitoring kube events for ContainerReady.
Kai (support): Posted status update to status.redwood.ai and sent targeted emails to 12 affected orgs.
incident-bot: Autopager check: 30m since ack — no further escalations.
Eric (oncall): Confirming last 10m: error rate for shard-12 at normal baseline. Switching route back to primary after verifying KV compaction safe? Recommend leave fallback for 15m to ensure no re-eviction.
Sandeep (runtime): I'll keep fallback for 20m, deploy runtime patch to add a memory headroom guard. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pulls/4523
Eric (oncall): Handing incident to Sandeep for follow-up and postmortem. Sandeep owns RCA and customer impact calc. I'll update PD: resolving for oncall.
PagerDuty: Incident #INC2400123456 acknowledged -> resolved by Eric (oncall) at 2400123678.
Sandeep (runtime): Thanks — will run deeper logs, correlate with recent driver upgrade window, and add regression test for KV compaction.
Jess (product): Please include list of affected customers and timeline for credit decision in PM notes.
Kai (support): I'll keep watch on customer responses and keep the status page live until SLOs are stable.
Eric (oncall): Final note: root cause preliminary = driver-version + KV cache compaction corner-case leading to OOM on worker. Follow-ups: infra node upgrade validation, runtime guard, alert tuning for early cache pressure.
Sandeep (runtime): Understood. Will schedule postmortem doc and assign action items.
Kai (support): Thx team — thumbs for quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
